info.description: A workout tracking web application for personal use (or family, friends), geared towards running and other GPX-based activities
info.title: Workout Tracker

get.description: Returns a list of all users in the system (admin only)
Returns detailed information about a specific user (admin only)

put.description: Updates user information including name, username, admin status, and password (admin only)

delete.description: Permanently deletes a user and all associated data (admin only)

get.description: Returns version, configuration and other app information (public endpoint)

get.summary: List the daily measurements of the current user

parameters.description: Number of measurements to return; default 50; -1 is no limit
parameters.name: limit

post.summary: Update the daily measurement of the current user

get.description: Returns a paginated list of equipment (shoes, bikes, etc.) for the current user
Returns detailed information about a specific equipment item

parameters.description: Program that generates the workout file
parameters.name: program

get.description: Returns a paginated list of daily measurements (weight, height, steps) for the current user

post.description: Creates or updates a daily measurement entry (weight, height, steps)

delete.description: Deletes a daily measurement entry for a specific date

get.description: Returns the current user's complete profile including all settings and preferences

put.description: Updates the current user's profile settings and preferences

post.description: Marks all workouts of the current user for background refresh
Generates a new API key for the current user, invalidating the old one
Records the app version last used by the current user

get.description: Returns personal records for the current user across all workout types
Returns a paginated list of saved route segments

post.description: Creates a new route segment from GPX file upload

get.description: Returns detailed information about a specific route segment

put.description: Updates route segment metadata (name, notes, settings)

get.description: Downloads the original route segment file (GPX)

post.description: Initiates background search for workouts that match this route segment
Refreshes route segment data and recalculates statistics

get.description: Returns aggregated statistics for the current user over a specified time range
Returns aggregated totals for the current user's workouts
Returns the profile and settings of the currently authenticated user
Returns a paginated list of workouts for the current user with optional filters

post.description: Creates a new workout from file upload (GPX, TCX, FIT) or manual entry

get.description: Returns workouts formatted as calendar events for the current user
Returns the geographic center point of each workout for map visualization
Returns all GPS coordinates from all workouts for heatmap visualization
Returns detailed information about a publicly shared workout (no authentication required)
Returns recent workouts from all users (for social/feed functionality)

parameters.description: Maximum number of workouts to return (max 100)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Returns detailed information about a specific workout including all GPS data

put.description: Updates workout details (name, notes, equipment, etc.)

delete.description: Permanently deletes a workout and all associated data

get.summary: Break down a workdown per units

get.description: Downloads the original workout file (GPX, TCX, FIT)

post.description: Marks a workout for background refresh to recalculate all statistics
Extracts a route segment from an existing workout
Generates or regenerates a public share link for a workout
